verdict.rationale: Postman's quick-start docs show a real, runnable example (send a request to postman-echo.com/get and view the response) and the API Network lets users 'find any API' with published collections/docs, plus response visualization and Spec Hub for API structure exploration — all consistent with an interactive, runnable API reference. However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'published documentation with Run-in-Postman' interactive reference page or AI-specific reference browsing feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a generated public API reference page with embedded runnable/try-it examples, and any AI-native framing of browsing that reference.
